name: ntr_db_active_rep_headcount
xsql:
select count(*) as count from ShowIncentHierarchy(EffectiveAsOf= :v_qtr_start_date, ParentId = :v_master_position_id) hier 
inner join xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
on pta.position_id = hier.position_id
inner join $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING t
on t.title = pta.title_name
where hier.position_is_active = 'true'

---select 1 as count
